This generative music video about AI doom is entirely rendered via code and WebGL with deterministic frame-by-frame precision. 🎬⚡️

Building programmatic, broadcast-quality videos with web tech has always been a massive pain—especially when trying to sync complex graphics, lyrics, and audio without timing drift. 

Enter mexicat/pdoom-video: a production-grade blueprint for building programmatic, frame-accurate video generation pipelines using TypeScript, Three.js, and headless browsers. 

Here is what makes it a game-changer for creative technologists and graphics developers:

✨ Deterministic Timeline Playback: Every single frame is a pure function of song time, guaranteeing identical output whether you are running a live browser preview or an offline 4K60 export.
🎞️ Advanced Offline Rendering: Uses headless Chrome and Playwright to dynamically calculate up to 324 sub-frames per frame for high-fidelity motion blur.
🎵 Automated Alignment: Features an audio and lyric alignment toolkit using Demucs stem separation, CTC forced alignment, and Whisper cross-checking for precise beat grids and word-level timings.
🎨 Modular Scene Architecture: Powered by Three.js and custom post-processing shaders (bloom, halation, grain) to render diverse visual plates from vector typography to ray-marched environments.

Whether you are building automated lyric video tools or pushing the limits of WebGL rendering, this repo bridges the gap between web graphics and offline rendering perfection.

Check out the code and start building your own programmatic video pipelines today:
https://github.com/mexicat/pdoom-video

Tired of writing brittle boilerplate code just to chain APIs together or orchestrate multi-step AI agents? 🤖⚙️

Bridging visual workflow building with modern agentic AI patterns, n8n lets developers rapidly prototype, self-host, and scale complex automation pipelines without architectural lock-in. 

Building complex workflow automations and multi-step AI agents usually means wrestling with custom orchestration layers, error handling, retries, and webhook management. n8n solves this by combining an intuitive node-based visual canvas with the ultimate flexibility of custom code, letting you connect disparate systems and process data seamlessly.

Here is why backend, AI, and DevOps engineers are adding it to their stack:

🧠 AI-Native and Model Agnostic: Build autonomous agents and workflows integrating OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models without altering your core architecture.
💻 Code When You Need It: Blend visual design with native execution of JavaScript, Python, and custom npm packages for advanced data transformations.
🔌 Massive Ecosystem: Out-of-the-box support for over 1,500 pre-built integrations and thousands of templates to connect your enterprise and developer tooling instantly.
🔒 Enterprise-Ready and Self-Hostable: Maintain strict data residency control with Docker-based deployment, RBAC, audit trails, and secure handling of sensitive payloads.

From orchestrating autonomous customer support agents querying internal vector databases to building bulletproof data ingestion pipelines, n8n cuts down implementation time from days to minutes.

Stop wasting compute on text generation when all you need is a fast decision. ⚡

If you are building intelligent routing systems, agentic workflows, or local AI pipelines, you know the pain of using massive text-generation models just to classify intent, score sentiment, or handle zero-shot triage. It introduces unnecessary latency, heavy overhead, and unpredictable outputs. 

Meet Ollaya: the local-first engine designed specifically for open decision, routing, and classification models. 

Instead of generating raw text, Ollaya reads your data and returns calibrated probabilities and structured states in a single, lightning-fast forward pass—all in milliseconds and entirely on your local hardware. 🚀

Here is why AI engineers and backend devs are adding it to their stack:

* TypeSafe-Compatible API: Switch your existing clients over instantly by changing just a single environment variable.
* Dual Execution Backends: Choose between ONNX Runtime for optimized CPU/CUDA performance and llama.cpp for GGUF-native models like winnow and jevk5.
* Native MCP Support: Out-of-the-box integration with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor for local agent workflows.
* Flexible Modelfiles: Easily configure custom question sets, precision adjustments, and task-specific parameters.

Whether you are automating customer support ticket triage before hitting downstream LLMs, securing safety moderation, or implementing zero-shot intent routing, Ollaya drops straight into your existing architecture with zero token generation lag.

👉 Check out the repo and drop a star: https://github.com/ollaya-dev/ollaya

Ever waste hours hunting down institutional knowledge scattered across Slack, Notion, and old GitHub PRs? 

Meet Company Brain—an open-source, context-aware AI teammate built to live directly in your Slack workspace and stop the cycle of technical amnesia. 🧠

🔥 THE PROBLEM:
Institutional knowledge fragmentation kills engineering velocity. Important decisions get buried in chat threads, documentation goes stale, and onboarding new devs takes weeks because context is trapped in silos.

⚡️ WHAT IT DOES:
Company Brain is a production-grade serverless AI agent built on TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, and D1. It continuously ingests your team's context to proactively answer questions, execute technical tasks, and automate triage—using *only* your internal data, never generic web assumptions.

🛠 KEY FEATURES:
• Strict Permission-Aware Memory: Respects user access boundaries by reading exclusively from channels and tools you are authorized to view.
• Proactive Participation: Autonomously chimes in on conversations when it detects relevant context or known past solutions.
• Built-in Code Sandbox: Clones repos, runs scripts, and returns generated charts, CSVs, or PDFs right in your chat.
• MCP-Powered Ecosystem: Leverages the Model Context Protocol to seamlessly integrate with GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Google Workspace.

Whether you want to automate first-line incident response or centralize architecture decisions without forcing your team to manually update wikis, this is your blueprint for a cost-effective internal platform.

👉 Deploy it with a single click and check out the architecture:
https://github.com/supermemoryai/company-brain

When your media extraction pipeline needs to be bulletproof against site changes, yt-dlp remains the ultimate developer utility. 

Building automated content ingestion, media archiving, or speech-to-text transcription services means dealing with fragile browser automation and constantly shifting API endpoints. If you are an AI engineer or backend developer tired of broken scrapers, yt-dlp solves this by abstracting away protocol complexities across thousands of web platforms.

Whether you are building data collection pipelines for machine learning models or self-hosted archiving systems, this tool gives you programmatical reliability.

Key Developer Features:
- Extensive site support with active maintenance ensuring high uptime
- Advanced format selection and filtering to grab exact video and audio streams
- Built-in post-processing like SponsorBlock integration and metadata manipulation
- A robust Python embedding API for seamless integration into your automated workflows

Check out the repository and start building better pipelines today:
